ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc_remeasure.note: Informational and dated.  The R3 gate binds at M1 against this row and not against the carried ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc row.  value is median_ms divided by lines over 1000.  S0-D7: the timed pair of the brief is a clean followed by a build of ./vendor/kanon/lib through dev/dunecho.sh, and neither half is reachable through that runner.  dunecho takes one MODE and no path, so it refuses a directory argument, and it holds no clean mode.  In the repository the vendored directory is also outside the default alias, so a root build compiles no vendored file until an overlay depends on it.  The measured pair is therefore a removal of _build followed by a build through the same runner script, taken over a copy of the vendored lib tree that holds lib/, dune-project, dune and dev/dunecho.sh only, so that the build compiles the named corpus and nothing else.  The copy is its own dune workspace root.  Stage A repeats the measurement inside the repository, where the D3 overlay makes the vendored library a build dependency.

method: Every number carries its date and its source.  kanon_pin is the sha in PIN, read by git -C /Users/oobi/Documents/mechanism-lang/vendor/kanon rev-parse HEAD and by git -C /Users/oobi/Documents/mechanism-lang ls-files -s vendor/kanon.  ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc is copied from the kanon pin file /Users/oobi/Documents/mechanism-lang-kanon-pin/dev/denominators.json with its five fields and its NOISY mark, and it is not re-derived.  ocamlopt_ms_per_kloc_remeasure is measured on 2026-09-07 by zsh dev/bench.sh, which runs the command once untimed as a warm-up, then five timed runs of /bin/zsh -f -c CMD under /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -P with time.perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run and stdin, stdout and stderr on /dev/null, and prints median, min and max in milliseconds.  The timed command removes _build with rm -rf and then runs zsh dev/dunecho.sh build, the runner that puts /Users/oobi/.opam/zxcaml-p1/bin first on PATH, takes its root from its own path and execs /Users/oobi/.local/bin/dunecho.  The corpus is the vendored kanon lib/*.ml and lib/*.mli at the pin, counted by wc -l as 6,215 lines over 24 files, and value is median_ms divided by 6.215.  kanon_check_ms_per_kloc, uat_export_sha256, lean_warm_uat_ms and lean_warm_auction_ms are copied from the design verdict probes named in each row and none of them is re-derived here.  Host facts come from uname -m, getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN and sw_vers -productVersion, because sysctl is denied in the agent sandbox.  ocaml_version comes from ocamlopt -version and dune_version from dune --version, both read from the zxcaml-p1 switch on 2026-09-07 and both reported by dev/dunecho.sh at build time.  dev/DENOMINATORS.sha256 holds the digest of this file, written by shasum -a 256 denominators.json from inside dev/, and the DENOMINATORS gate leg checks it.  A re-measurement is a new dated file and never an overwrite of this one.
